description.value: Hotel Beacon is a historic hotel on Broadway in the Upper West Side, known for its apartment-style rooms. Many rooms include kitchenettes, which helps families and longer stays save on meals. Central Park and Zabar's are a short walk away, giving it a true neighborhood feel.
